name: Capital And Labor
overview: The parable in Matthew 21:33-38 reveals the tension between capital and labor through the story of a householder who entrusts his vineyard to husbandmen. The servants sent to collect the fruit are violently rejected, culminating in the husbandmen's plot to kill the householder's son to seize his inheritance. This narrative highlights the dangers of rebellion against rightful authority and the consequences of rejecting the owner's just claims, illustrating a profound conflict between those who provide resources and those who work them.
